copilot.notes: Use command flags such as --allow-all for permissions; slash commands like /allow-all may not execute when sent through subprocess stdin. mode controls Copilot execution. stage2Mode=subprocess shows live output in the UI; stage2Mode=handoff saves a task file for the current Copilot CLI session. passPrompt supports stdin, argument, or promptFile. If command contains {prompt_file}, passPrompt is treated as promptFile.
